title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant & Payroll Coordinator

Location: Durham
Salary: £35,000+ DOE
Hours: 37.5 hours per week (Monday to Friday)
Working Hours: 8:00am-4:00pm, 8:30am-4:30pm, or 9:00am-5:00pm
Holiday: 25 days plus bank holidays (7 days reserved for Christmas shutdown)

My client is a successful and rapidly growing business that has recently expanded its operations with multiple new offices. They are looking to recruit a proactive and driven Accounts Assistant & Payroll Coordinator who can take ownership of key finance processes and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of the business.

This is a varied, hands-on position that will combine accounting, payroll and CIS responsibilities, while also providing the opportunity to become involved in month-end processes, VAT submissions and ongoing improvements across the finance function.

Key Responsibilities
- Process weekly/monthly payroll, ensuring all payroll data is accurate and submitted within agreed deadlines.
- Post and allocate bank transactions, maintaining accurate financial records across the finance systems.
- Process, review and validate supplier invoices, ensuring all costs are correctly coded and authorised.
- Process subcontractor invoices and maintain accurate CIS records.
- Prepare supplier payment runs and subcontractor payment schedules for approval and payment.
- Review employee expense claims, checking receipts and supporting documentation, maintaining expense records within Excel and preparing payment lists.
- Process employee expenses within Sage.
- Complete CIS reconciliations and ensure compliance with relevant regulations.
- Respond to payroll, supplier and subcontractor queries in a timely manner.
- Produce and maintain reports using Excel to support finance operations and decision-making.
- Support the development and improvement of finance processes, systems and reporting capabilities.
- Build strong working relationships with site teams and operational departments to ensure the smooth flow of payroll and expense information.
- Provide support and guidance to a junior member of the accounts team.

Month-End Responsibilities
- Complete bank reconciliations and investigate any outstanding variances.
- Perform payroll reconciliations to ensure accuracy between payroll and financial records.
- Post job costing and overhead allocations, including:
- Company vans
- Company cars
- Fuel costs
- Assist with the preparation of month-end accounts and management reporting.
- Support VAT return preparation and submissions.
- Produce travel expense analysis for Head Office.
- Reconcile supplier statements and investigate any discrepancies.
- Assist in maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring month-end deadlines are achieved.

About You
- Has experience within accounts and payroll
- Has CIS knowledge and experience
- Is confident using Excel and accounting systems such as Sage
- Can work independently and take ownership of processes

The Opportunity

This is an excellent opportunity to join a business during an exciting period of growth. The role offers genuine responsibility, exposure to a broad range of finance activities and the chance to make a real impact on the development of the finance function while working as part of a close-knit and supportive team.

If you're interested, please submit your CV now!

title: Accounts Payable Assistant

What will you be doing?

title: Accounts Payable Clerk
description:
ACCOUNTS PAYABLE CLERK

Durham
£30,000 £35,000
25 days holiday + bank holidays
Flexible working hours, 9am -5pm equivalent

I'm delighted to be exclusively partnering with an established North East construction company who are looking to welcome an experienced Accounts Payable Clerk to their team.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a business with a genuinely lovely working environment, a down-to-earth team and plenty of opportunities to get involved across different departments.

The role

A key part of your responsibility will be managing weekly PAYE and weekly CIS subcontractor payroll, ensuring timesheets are processed accurately, discrepancies are resolved and payments are made on time. You will also support the Accounts Manager with monthly PAYE payroll when required.

You'll be the go-to person for subcontractors when it comes to payment queries, so I'm looking for someone who understands the importance of building strong working relationships, communicating effectively and making sure people are looked after.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Weekly processing PAYE and CIS subcontractor timesheets through a digital application, investigating and resolving any discrepancies.
- Managing subcontractor payment queries and ensuring payments are processed accurately and on time.
- Processing accounts payable invoices in line with agreed payment terms and timescales.
- Working with SAGE 200 and Eque 2 software.
- Processing expense claims
- Supporting the Accounts Manager with HMRC submissions
- Supporting procurement and month-end accounting activities as and when required.

Who am I looking for?

First and foremost, experience processing payroll is an absolute must. This is the one requirement I can't compromise on. Knowledge of CIS subcontractor payments would also be great!

You'll ideally be a confident user of SAGE 200, with experience of Eque 2 being a real advantage.

But beyond your technical experience, I'm looking for the right personality.

Someone who's proactive, driven and takes real ownership of their responsibilities. A natural relationship builder who genuinely enjoys helping people, thinks outside the box and doesn't need to be asked twice to get things done.

You'll be working in an open-plan construction office, so you'll need to enjoy a bit of banter, have a good sense of humour and be confident enough to hold your own.

This isn't a business where you'll be expected to sit quietly behind a desk processing invoices all day. They want someone who enjoys being part of the wider team, is happy to get stuck in and welcomes the opportunity to be cross-trained across other departments.

What's on offer?

Salary between £30,000 £35,000 depending on experience.

25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.

Flexible working hours, typically 9am 5pm or similar.

A friendly, supportive team with a genuinely great working atmosphere.

Opportunities to develop your skills and gain exposure to other areas of the business.

This is a lovely opportunity for someone who wants to feel valued, take ownership of their role and become an important part of a growing construction business.

If you have the Payroll & CIS experience I'm looking for and think this sounds like your kind of workplace, I'd love to hear from you!

Consula is recruiting on behalf of a growing professional services group with its northern hub in Newcastle upon Tyne for an organised and confident Credit Controller.

Our client has built a strong reputation for reliable service and long-standing customer relationships, and as the business continues to grow, they are strengthening their finance team with a credit control specialist who can protect cash flow while keeping customers on side.

In this role, you will own a ledger serving corporate and public sector clients across the North East and Scotland. You will be the friendly, persistent voice that keeps accounts up to date, resolving queries quickly and making sure payments arrive on time. Your work has a direct impact on the business's cash position, its customer relationships and the accuracy of month-end reporting.

The office sits close to Newcastle Central Station and the Metro, making it an easy daily commute from across Tyneside, Northumberland and County Durham.

Location: Newcastle

Salary: £36,000 - £39,500 per year

Employment: Permanent

THE ROLE

As Credit Controller, you will manage the full collections cycle for your ledger, working closely with sales, customer service and the wider finance team.
- Managing a designated sales ledger, chasing overdue balances by telephone and email in a professional, solution-focused way.
- Prioritising collections activity using aged debt reports to reduce debtor days and keep overdue balances under control.
- Investigating and resolving invoice queries, disputes and pricing discrepancies with internal teams.
- Setting up and monitoring payment plans, and escalating persistent non-payment in line with credit policy.
- Allocating cash receipts and reconciling customer accounts accurately and promptly.
- Carrying out credit checks on new and existing customers and recommending appropriate credit limits.
- Placing accounts on stop where required and communicating clearly with account managers.
- Preparing weekly cash forecasts and aged debt reports for the Finance Manager.
- Supporting month-end close, audit requests and continuous improvement of the credit control process.

ABOUT YOU

Our client is keen to meet people who are calm under pressure, persuasive on the phone and meticulous with detail.

Essential:
- Proven experience in credit control, collections or accounts receivable.
- Confident, courteous telephone manner with the resilience to handle difficult conversations.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage a high volume of accounts at once.
- Good working knowledge of Excel, including filters, lookups and pivot tables.
- High standards of accuracy when allocating cash and reconciling accounts.

Desirable:
- Experience of accounting systems such as Sage, Xero, SAP, Dynamics or similar.
- Understanding of credit checking tools and the debt recovery process.
- AAT or CICM qualification, or working towards one.

A TYPICAL DAY

You will start the morning by reviewing yesterday's receipts, allocating cash and checking which accounts are now due or overdue. Mid-morning is focused on your call list, speaking with customers, agreeing payment dates and logging every conversation. In the afternoon you will chase up outstanding queries with colleagues in sales and operations, review credit applications and update your aged debt report, finishing the day with a clear plan of priorities for tomorrow.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT
- A secure, permanent role within an established and supportive Newcastle finance team.
- 28 days' annual leave including bank holidays.
- Workplace pension scheme with employer contributions.
- Study support towards AAT or CICM qualifications for the right person.
- Structured induction and clear progression routes within the finance function.
- A friendly team culture with regular recognition of good work.
- Health and wellbeing support, including an employee assistance programme.

If you are a determined, organised credit control professional looking for your next step, we would be delighted to hear from you. Apply through Consula today and Doug, our AI talent partner, will be in touch to discuss the role further.
